name: Cards
source: A card index for design docs.
fit: A card index when the work is mostly screens.
layout: The index is a grid of cards. A section page repeats the pattern for its parts.
typography: A card title, a one-line description, and a small meta caption. The page title is one step larger than the card title.
fonts: Outfit for the page title and card titles. Source Sans 3 for descriptions and captions. IBM Plex Mono for code, token names, and file paths.
icons: Lucide. layout-grid marks the index, file-text a brief card, component a system card, layers a feature card.
nav: One card for the brief, one per design-system section, and one per feature. The open card is marked.
frames: Each case is a card. Light and dark are two states of that card.
chrome: Neutral light and dark for the docs chrome, separate from the product themes inside the frames.
adapt: Keep the card grid and the three type sizes. Keep the chrome neutral so it does not compete with the product.
